body_en: Honesty in study means no cheating and no fake progress. If you did not prepare, say so and plan repair time. Help a classmate without doing the work for them. Courage is speaking up when something unfair happens in class.
body_zh: 学习上的诚实：不作弊、不假装进步。没准备就直说，并安排补救时间。帮同学，但不要替他做完。课堂上不公时敢说出来，也是勇气。
